smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: Spacely AI
shortDescription: Turns a sketch, a 3D model, or a room photo into a photoreal render. No card to start.
longDescription: Spacely AI turns a sketch, a 3D model, or a room photo into a photoreal render and says the render can finish in under 60 seconds. Plugins are listed for SketchUp, with Rhino and Revit named as well. Creating an account does not require a card. A June 2026 pricing post says a lapsed Personal plan returns at $25 a month for 500 credits, Studio at $50 a month for 1,500 credits, and Agency at $100 a month for 3,500 credits.
pricingNotes: No card is required to create an account. A lapsed Personal plan is $25 per month for 500 credits, Studio is $50 per month for 1,500 credits, and Agency is $100 per month for 3,500 credits.
freeTierNotes: Account creation does not require a card.
bestFor: A sketch or room photo that should become a photoreal render
A SketchUp view you want to render without leaving the model
notIdealFor: A measured floor plan delivered from a phone scan
Virtual staging priced per listing photo
strength: Spacely AI turns a sketch, a 3D model, or a room photo into a photoreal render, and signup does not require a card.
weakness: A lapsed Personal plan is $25 per month, and the AutoCAD connection was still described as upcoming on the pricing post.
